spec.method: leave one member out of the fixed ladder book, re-weight the survivors to stay fully invested, re-annualise the level on the surviving months
spec.units: annualised bp of the era (mean monthly x 12 x 1e4)

honest: level survival is a statement about the ERA LEVEL, not about the strategy: a level that needs one holding to keep its sign is a holding, not a book
the re-weighting makes the drop a different book, which is the point: comparing an un-invested remainder against a fully invested book would understate every drop
a month the dropped name alone could hold is excluded from both sides and published, never read as a zero return
descriptive census only: no gate, no prereg, no trial count
